meta.title: LaunchDesk - Employee onboarding without chaos
meta.description: Onboard new employees in one place. Task templates, documents, assignments with due dates and a live dashboard, so every new hire has a great first week.

hero.title: Onboarding without chaos
hero.subtitle: Give every new hire a clear, step-by-step path and give your team one place to run it. Tasks, documents, assignments and progress, all in LaunchDesk.
hero.trust: Free to start. Sign in with email, Google or GitHub. No credit card required.

problems.title: Onboarding should not feel like chaos
problems.subtitle: Scattered documents, repetitive reminders and no clear picture of who is done with what. That is how most first weeks look, and it shows.

visibility.title: No visibility into the process
visibility.description: It is hard to tell which steps are done, which are stuck and which new hire needs help today.

documents.title: Documents all over the place
documents.description: Contracts, guidelines and handbooks live in inboxes, drives and chats, so nobody is sure which version is current.

repetition.title: The same manual work, every time
repetition.description: Sending the same documents and reminders by hand eats time that should go into welcoming people.

delays.title: Workstations ready too late
delays.description: Equipment, accounts and access are prepared at the last minute and the first days are spent waiting.

howItWorks.title: From template to finished onboarding in four steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Build the process once, then run it for every new hire with a few clicks.

templates.title: Build task templates
templates.description: Break onboarding into clear steps with descriptions, attachments and optional required notes.

invite.title: Invite your team
invite.description: Add managers and new hires by email invite. They can sign in with a password, Google or GitHub.

assign.title: Assign with due dates
assign.description: Assign a task to one or many people, set a due date and LaunchDesk tracks who is on time and who is late.

track.title: Track progress live
track.description: The dashboard shows status, activity over time and team workload, so you always know where to step in.

features.title: Everything you need to run onboarding
features.subtitle: No add-ons, no spreadsheets on the side. The whole process lives in one tool.

templates.title: Reusable task templates
templates.description: Define steps once, reuse them for every hire. Each step can carry attachments and require a note before it is marked done.

documents.title: Document library with preview
documents.description: Upload PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets and images. Open them right in the browser, no download needed.

assignments.title: Assignments and due dates
assignments.description: Assign tasks to individuals or groups, set deadlines and see overdue work highlighted automatically.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and reports
dashboard.description: Completion rate, status breakdown, created vs. completed over time and workload per team member.

roles.title: Roles and invitations
roles.description: Owners and admins run the process, users see only their own tasks. Invite anyone with a single email.

player.title: Guided task player
player.description: New hires move through their steps one at a time, read instructions, download files and mark progress.

free.question: Is LaunchDesk free to use?
free.answer: Yes. Create an account, set up your organization and start onboarding right away. No credit card is needed.

templates.question: Can I reuse the same onboarding for every new hire?
templates.answer: Yes. Build a task template once, with steps, attachments and optional required notes, then assign it to every new hire in a few clicks.

documents.question: Where are uploaded documents stored?
documents.answer: Documents are stored in secure cloud object storage and served through short-lived, signed links, so only signed-in members of your organization can open them.

roles.question: Who can see what?
roles.answer: Owners and admins manage users, tasks, documents and assignments. Regular users only see the tasks assigned to them and their own settings.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: LaunchDesk is available in English and Polish. Every member can pick their own language in settings.

setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: Minutes. Register, name your organization, create your first task template and invite your first new hire.

finalCta.title: Give your next hire a better first week
finalCta.subtitle: Set up LaunchDesk today and run your next onboarding from one place.
